$comment: The build (tsconfig.json) only covers src/**/*.ts. That left the ONE file every
consumer actually executes -- bin/cli.mjs, the `bin` entry in package.json --
checked by nothing: not by tsc, not by a linter. A typo in an argv branch there
ships to npm and fails on the user's machine while CI stays green.
This config typechecks the shipped JavaScript via allowJs + checkJs. It is a
separate file rather than folded into tsconfig.json because (a) rootDir: src +
outDir: dist cannot also emit for bin/, and (b) this config must not emit at all
-- bin/cli.mjs is published verbatim and must never be overwritten by a compile
Scope is deliberately just the published entrypoint. examples/ and test/ are
development-only: a type error there cannot reach a consumer, and pulling them in
adds ~40 errors that would gate every PR on fixing fixtures. If they are ever
added, do it as its own pass -- do not widen this include silently.
